queries.Context: Overarching experimental framew: Experimental paradigms for comparing temporal context effects on visual perception across micro, meso, and macro time scales within a single experimental framework using serial visual stimuli, speeded binary judgments, task-related and task-unrelated spatial reference planes, EEG, pupillometry, and predictive coding mechanisms of expected versus unexpected events.
queries.Context: Core behavioral task that gener: serial visual history in speeded binary judgments with randomly positioned Gaussian blobs around central fixation, task-related and task-unrelated spatial reference planes, temporal context across multiple time scales
queries.Context: Attentional dissociation betwee: Attentional dissociation of task-related and task-unrelated spatial history effects on visual perception using binary left-right judgments and orthogonal above-below reference planes in serially presented visual stimuli
queries.Context: Experiment 1 establishes baseli: speeded binary judgments on randomly positioned visual stimuli with occasional reproduction task measuring recall precision and serial dependence to establish baseline temporal context effects across micro meso and macro scales
queries.Context: Experiment 1 analyses quantify: behavioral analysis of micro and meso temporal context in visual perception using repeat versus alternate trials, five-event sequences, and continuous angular serial dependence from previous stimuli
queries.Context: Experiment 2 tests macro-scale: macro-scale temporal context effects on visual perception induced by probabilistic biases of repeat versus alternate stimuli, with task-related and task-unrelated spatial reference planes, counterbalanced expectation manipulations, behavioral precision, EEG decoding, and pupillometry
queries.Context: Experiment 3 controls for varia: fixed 200 ms stimulus duration control for variable presentation time confounds in probabilistic visual temporal context experiments measuring expected versus unexpected effects on speeded binary judgments across task-related and task-unrelated spatial planes
queries.Context: Behavioral outcome measures acr: behavioral outcome measures response time accuracy recall precision across task-related and task-unrelated spatial reference planes in temporal context visual perception experiments with serially presented stimuli and speeded binary judgments
queries.Context: Neural data source chosen to av: EEG reanalysis of a published visual target monitoring dataset to examine temporal context effects on perception across micro, meso, macro scales using multivariate decoding, inverted encoding modeling, without motor confounds
queries.Context: Multivariate neural analysis of: EEG multivariate linear discriminant analysis and inverted encoding modeling for classifying visual stimulus locations and reconstructing stimulus features over time in serial visual perception with temporal context and expected versus unexpected stimuli
queries.Context: Neural expected versus unexpect: EEG neural decoding accuracy and precision for expected versus unexpected visual stimuli in repeat versus alternate trials across micro, meso, and macro temporal sequence types
queries.Context: Physiological index of expected: pupillometry assessment of pupil dilation responses to expected versus unexpected visual events during temporal context predictive coding paradigms
queries.Context: Theoretical test of whether pre: Theoretical and empirical evidence for predictive coding mechanisms that dampen or sharpen neural representations of expected versus unexpected visual events, assessed through behavioral precision and EEG decoding accuracy across temporal context.
queries.Context: Statistical inference for neura: cluster-corrected statistical analysis for identifying significant time periods in EEG neural data and non-parametric tests for behavioral measures in temporal context visual perception experiments
